emotional_tone: Playful, adventurous, nostalgic, and highly interactive.
design_rationale: For a kids' educational 3D game with a retro indie aesthetic, the UI must balance nostalgic pixel/blocky visuals with modern usability. We use Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) but style it with Neo-brutalist/Retro chunky borders, solid drop shadows, and high-contrast primary colors. The 3D world (React Three Fiber) handles the immersion, while the 2D UI remains flat, legible, and tactile.

spacing_and_layout.hud_layout: fixed top-0 left-0 w-full p-6 flex justify-between items-start pointer-events-none
spacing_and_layout.hud_elements: pointer-events-auto bg-white border-4 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] p-4

ui_components.buttons: Chunky, flat colors (Primary Yellow or Secondary Red), 4px black border, solid black 4px drop shadow. Hover state translates down and right to simulate a physical button press.
ui_components.cards_modals: Flat white background, 4px black border, solid black shadow. High contrast, no gradient. Inside padding p-8.
ui_components.hud_score: Top left. Displays collected letters and current score. Uses heading font (VT323).
ui_components.hud_controls: Top right. Pause button, settings toggle.
ui_components.menus: Main menu and pause menu should be centered modals with heavy retro styling. Background overlay: bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm.

three_d_guidelines.aesthetic: Low-resolution, flat shading or basic lambert materials. Blocky/Voxel style.

environment.ground: Pixelated green grass texture or flat green with grid
environment.platforms: Three distinct colored floating platforms (blue, red, yellow)

three_d_guidelines.lighting: Bright ambient light + directional light for harsh, simple shadows. Avoid complex PBR materials.
three_d_guidelines.camera: Third-person follow camera, slight top-down angle for platforming clarity.
three_d_guidelines.animations: Simple, snappy animations. Floating letters bob up and down with rotation.

motion_and_interactions.ui_hover: Tactile click (translate X and Y by 2px, reduce shadow to 2px).
motion_and_interactions.item_collection: Scale up, spin faster, then pop/disappear with a particle burst (using Drei's sparkle or simple small cubes).

assets.icons: lucide-react (using bold strokeWidth=3 to match chunky style) or custom CSS pixel icons.

testing.attributes: All interactive buttons and HUD elements MUST use data-testid. e.g., data-testid='play-button', data-testid='pause-menu'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install VT323 and Fredoka fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the menu UI, as Shadcn's refined look conflicts with the requested Retro Indie Neo-brutalist aesthetic.
Implement WASD movement and jump using a basic physics engine wrapper (like @react-three/rapier) or custom frame loop.
Ensure UI is an overlay (z-index 50) on top of the fullscreen Canvas component.
All buttons must have the solid black border and shadow style for the tactile retro feel.
